abstract: Adnexal masses are common in pregnancy, with 2-10% of pregnancies presenting with an ovarian mass and approximately 1-6% of these masses being malignant. For suspected malignancy or masses with symptoms, surgery must be performed as early as possible. We retrospectively investigated the effect of two-port laparoscopic surgery on the outcomes of patients with concurrent adnexal masses between 2012 and 2019 (including large mucinous tumor, large teratoma, serous borderline tumor, and heterotopic pregnancy). Laparoscopic right partial oophorectomy was performed for a 27 cm ovarian mucinous tumor at a gestational age (GA) of 21 weeks, laparoscopic right oophorocystectomy for an 18 cm teratoma at a GA of 10 weeks, and laparoscopic left salpingo-oophorectomy for a 7 cm serous borderline tumor at a GA of 7 weeks after ultrasonographic confirmation of an intrauterine gestational sac with a fetal heartbeat. Laparoscopic excision of a tubal pregnancy was performed in a heterotopic pregnancy at a GA of 12 weeks with massive internal bleeding. Laparoscopic surgery is easier and safe to perform during early pregnancy because a smaller uterus allows for superior visualization. All of these patients had optimal postoperative recovery and normal spontaneous delivery at term. We discussed several aspects of treatment and delivery, namely treatment option (expectant management or surgery), surgery timing (early or advanced pregnancy), surgery type (laparoscopy or laparotomy), and delivery route (normal spontaneous delivery or cesarean section), in patients with concurrent adnexal tumors and their effects on pregnancy outcomes.
abstract_ja: 付属器腫瘤は妊娠中に一般的にみられ、妊娠の2〜10%で卵巣腫瘤が認められ、そのうち約1〜6%は悪性である。悪性が疑われる場合や症状を伴う腫瘤では、できるだけ早期に手術を行う必要がある。われわれは、2012年から2019年の間に合併付属器腫瘤(大型粘液性腫瘍、大型奇形腫、漿液性境界悪性腫瘍、異所性妊娠を含む)を有した患者において、二孔式腹腔鏡手術が転帰に与える影響を後方視的に検討した。妊娠21週で27cmの卵巣粘液性腫瘍に対して腹腔鏡下右卵巣部分切除術を、妊娠10週で18cmの奇形腫に対して腹腔鏡下右卵巣嚢腫摘出術を、妊娠7週で7cmの漿液性境界悪性腫瘍に対して腹腔鏡下左卵管卵巣摘除術を、胎嚢内に胎児心拍を伴う子宮内妊娠を超音波検査で確認した後に施行した。大量の腹腔内出血を伴う異所性妊娠の患者では、妊娠12週で腹腔鏡下に卵管妊娠の切除を施行した。妊娠初期は子宮が小さいため視野が良好で、腹腔鏡手術は行いやすく安全である。これらの患者はすべて術後の回復が良好で、満期での正常経腟分娩に至った。合併付属器腫瘍を有する患者の治療と分娩について、治療選択(待機的管理または手術)、手術時期(妊娠初期または後期)、手術方法(腹腔鏡手術または開腹術)、分娩経路(経腟分娩または帝王切開)といった側面を検討し、妊娠転帰への影響について考察した。
